title: Cloud Network Flow Anomaly SMB enumeration blocked

compliance.assurance_rationale: Saved search evidence for AU-2 when alert outputs are archived.

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay or inject sample `aws:vpcflow` events matching `action=REJECT` into `index=aws`. Confirm UC-4.13.14 search returns >=1 row and alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `aws:vpcflow` traffic without `action=REJECT` markers. Confirm the search returns zero rows and alert does not fire.

dataSources: `index=aws` sourcetype=`aws:vpcflow` collected via Splunk Add-on for AWS VPC flow logs; validate ingest with `| stats count by sourcetype`.

description: Monitors `aws:vpcflow` telemetry to detect cloud network flow anomaly smb enumeration blocked. Identifies anomalous or high-risk activity for security and operations review.

detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure Splunk Add-on for AWS VPC flow logs with the modular input for `aws:vpcflow`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.13.1.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `src` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=aws sourcetype=aws:vpcflow.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:vpcflow" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:vpcflow" dest_port=445 action=REJECT
| table _time src dest src_port dest_port action bytes
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.13.14_cloud_network_flow_anoma_14"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `aws:vpcflow` in `index=aws` to detect cloud network flow anomaly smb enumeration blocked. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the Amazon VPC console Flow logs for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `src` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_13_14_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk Add-on for AWS VPC flow logs and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of cloud network flow anomaly smb enumeration blocked so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
